messages:
Marta Delgado: Quick sync — finalizing the 'Neo onboard' newsletter for the benchmark webinar next Wed. Need final segment + subject A/B by EOD. Also need routing rules for inbound leads from the registration.
Alex Kim: Suggest split by product interest tag: infra vs platform. 70/30? include recent-trial cohort as separate slice.
Ryan O'Connor: Can we suppress anyone who got the product-update email last week? last send suppression list needed.
Sophia Patel: Yes — suppression list ready: `suppress_7d_product_update.csv`. I uploaded it to the campaign assets. Subject ideas: A) "Redwood inference: benchmark & live demo — Tue" B) "How we cut token costs in production — webinar"
Marta Delgado: Leaning B for NA (higher CTR) but run A as the APAC experiment. Also think about emoji in A for APAC? 🤔
Alex Kim: APAC send window should be 9am SGT (23:00 PST previous day). We'll need throttling to avoid SES spikes — recommend 3k/hr initial.
marketing-bot: Reminder: campaign `neo-onboard-bench` created. Template v3 uploaded: /templates/neo_onboard_v3.html. Preview link: https://campaigns.redwood.ai/preview/neo_onboard_v3
Ryan O'Connor: @OPS Scheduler — can you confirm SES quotas and whether we can do a ramp schedule?
OPS Scheduler: SES soft limit: 500k/day. Throttle plan OK. I'll schedule a ramp: 1k/hr for first hour -> 5k/hr for next two -> burst up to 20k over 2h if delivery healthy. Will post final timing.
Sophia Patel: Tracking params: `utm_campaign=neo_bench_v1` + `utm_source=newsletter`. Please append `?utm_campaign=neo_bench_v1&utm_source=newsletter` to all CTA links and the webinar register button. Also include `email_variant=A|B` for A/B consistency.
Marta Delgado: Quick checklist: [ ] segments uploaded & verified, [ ] suppression applied, [ ] template QA + inbox previews, [ ] tracking appended, [ ] scheduling confirmed. Who's owning QA?
Alex Kim: I'll own the QA pass — inbox previews + link checks — tomorrow at 10:30 PST. Ryan can validate tracking and the suppression logic after I finish.
Ryan O'Connor: I'll validate link params and the suppression join keys. Also ensure we have a plain-text fallback and check emoji rendering in Gmail.
Marta Delgado: Sweet. If no objections I will lock subject B for NA and subject A (with emoji) for APAC by 5pm PST today. Please post any objections here. :thumbsup:
Alex Kim: :thumbsup:
OPS Scheduler: Tentative scheduled send preview: 2026-03-24 17:00 UTC. Final send time will be confirmed after QA and suppression upload.
Marta Delgado: Thanks — I'll update the campaign description and push a final assets snapshot to the shared drive when QA is done.
Sophia Patel: Adding a tiny note — include a small blurb re: Dedicated capacity for enterprise customers in the 2nd module of the email (short, not salesy).
Marta Delgado: Good call. I'll draft the blurb and drop in the template now.
marketing-bot: Audit log: assets/upload/neo_onboard_v3.html by Sophia Patel at 2026-03-22T15:42:10Z.
Marta Delgado: Closing loop — will confirm final subject split + scheduling by 17:00 PST. Thanks team!
